messages:
support-ops: Incoming escalation from AcmeCorp — p95 went from ~120ms to ~900ms around 2026-03-15T09:10Z. No 5xxs, error rate steady. They attached traces showing long token emit times and lots of KV cache misses.
kevin: on it. do we have the pool + model details?
maria: pool-prod-05, model=rwkv-13b-q2a (redwood-quantized-v3). traffic spike from a batch job hitting many long prefixes. I see a correlation with yesterday's evict-tune deploy.
thomas: can you paste a sample trace? especially the cache key header and the worker logs.
support-ops: pasted from customer: ``curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"...","session_id":"acct-345:conv-987:turn-12"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``. Their traces show repeated KV miss logs like: `kv.get miss key=prefix:acct-345:conv-987:token-0` many times within the same request.
ollie: that smells like cache key normalization bug — session id sometimes contains suffixes (v1, v2, ephemeral ids) so prefix cardinality exploded. I noticed a change in prefix-key hashing in last deploy.
kevin: I pulled worker logs from pool-prod-05 at 2026-03-15T09:08..09:20 — observed churn: eviction rate spiked, hotset bounce, and warmup tasks couldn't keep up. p95 correlates with miss ratio increasing from 6% -> 48%.
maria: repro steps I used locally (fast):
```
# simulate heavy entropy prefixes
for i in {1..2000}; do 
  curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi","session_id":"acct-345:conv-'$i'"}' $ENDPOINT >/dev/null &
done
```
That brings miss-rate up and p95 jumps.
sre-bot: metric alert: kv.prefix_miss_rate > 0.35 for 12m on pool-prod-05. topology: 8 workers. recent deploy: evict-tuning/dynamic-probes @ 2026-03-14T22:05Z.
thomas: quick hypothesis list:
- cache key entropy increased (normalization bug)
- eviction policy now favors recency too strongly => hotset displacement
- warmup worker queue starved by high request concurrency
kevin: mitigation proposal (fast -> medium -> permanent):
1) fast: pin routing of AcmeCorp traffic to a small subset of workers (sticky-hash) to preserve warmed prefixes and reduce cross-host misses. enable via routing flag for 15m.
2) fast: increase prefix-cache size on pool-prod-05 by +30% (cheap, config-only) while we triage.
3) medium: revert the prefix-key hashing change to previous canonicalizer until we validate normalization logic.
4) medium: add a short-lived prefix TTL decay (e.g., soft-ttl 10m -> 30m) for prefixes seen > X times to prevent immediate eviction.
5) permanent: implement key-normalization middleware to canonicalize session ids and collapse ephemeral suffixes, plus an adaptive hotset scorer (LFU+decay) so eviction is not purely LRU.
ollie: note: sticky routing will impact load balancing. we should limit sticky window to 15m and only for clients with high miss-rate tag. ops runbook: how to flip routing?
maria: steps I used to pin: `redwoodctl route update --pool pool-prod-05 --selector client=acmecorp --sticky 900` tested on staging, reduced p95 by ~4x in short run.
kevin: added a small proof-of-concept prefetch warmup job: sample top-100 prefixes for the client and populate KV during slack capacity windows. This reduced misses locally.
thomas: for the normalization bug: quick diff shows commit 7c2b changed `sanitize_session()` to not strip transient suffixes. I'll open a revert PR with test cases for suffix patterns.
support-ops: we've alerted the customer about temporary mitigations (sticky pin + cache bump) and will schedule a private deploy of the revert.
ollie: monitoring checklist for rollout:
- kv.prefix_miss_rate per-client
- p95/p99 token emit latency per pool
- eviction_rate and warmup_queue_length
- worker cpu/gpu utilization (to watch for hot hot hosts)
kevin: small config note: when increasing cache size, watch memory pressure on worker; if memory crosses 82% we autoscale another instance.
maria: timeline: applied sticky routing + cache bump at 09:30Z. by 09:45Z customer p95 dropped from ~900ms -> ~160ms. still above baseline but acceptable. open PR for revert is #4571.
thomas: tests to add before revert deploy:
- unit tests for sanitize_session() with many suffix variants
- integration test that simulates 2k ephemeral prefixes and asserts miss rate stays below 10%
- regression test for eviction policy under synthetic hotset churn
sre-bot: action items assigned: kevin -> monitor & prefetch job; thomas -> revert PR + tests; maria -> customer comms and staged rollout; ollie -> telemetry dashboards update.
support-ops: closing loop: customer will keep us updated. we'll keep sticky/prefetch for 24h and then roll forward the revert+adaptive-evict. I'll update the ticket.
